steps.title: Steps
steps.meta: {count, number, credits} of {max, number, credits} · days count from launch
steps.locked: Steps can only be edited while the campaign is a draft.
steps.heading: Step {number, number, credits} · {channel}
steps.none: No steps yet: add one below.

fields.title: Fields
fields.meta: Each person's own value, from the list or the signal
fields.none: No fields yet. Add one with + Field under a step's message.
fields.help: Required: a person with no value does not get the steps that use the field. To remove a field, first remove its token from the steps.
fields.addLabel: Add a field from the list or the signal
fields.noColumns: The list has no columns to add.
fields.filled: {filled, number, credits} of {people, plural, one {# person} other {{people, number, credits} people}}
fields.fallbackPlaceholder: Text for a person with no value
fields.fallbackBlank: Write the fallback text, or pick Required.
fields.nobodyReady: {count, plural, one {# person misses} other {{count, number, credits} people miss}} a value for {fields}. Add the values to the list, or give each of these fields a fallback text.

senders.title: Send from
senders.description: Each person stays on the same mailbox for the whole thread.
senders.max: Up to {max, plural, one {# mailbox} other {{max, number, credits} mailboxes}} per campaign.
senders.keepOne: The campaign needs a mailbox that can send: add another before you remove this one.

when.title: When
when.fixed: Hours and days are the mailboxes' own and apply to every campaign.

approval.title: Approve messages before sending
approval.body: Always on: every message waits for your OK, person by person.

preview.title: Preview · step {number, number, credits}
preview.noSteps: Add a step to see the preview.
preview.failed: Preview not updated. Try editing the step again.
preview.missing: No value for {fields} for this person: the steps that use {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} are not sent.

blockers.noMailbox: No mailbox connected: the campaign cannot start.
blockers.pickMailbox: Pick a connected mailbox to send from.
blockers.noLinkedIn: Connect LinkedIn in Integrations for the LinkedIn steps.
blockers.noTargets: This campaign has nobody to contact.
blockers.noCopyB: The A/B test is on: write copy B for at least one step, or turn the test off.

source.linked: {count, plural, one {# person} other {{count, number, credits} people}} from {list} · exclusions already removed
source.gone: {count, plural, one {# person} other {{count, number, credits} people}} · the source list no longer exists

rewrite.prompt: Rewrite the message sequence of the campaign "{name}" (campaign_id {id}) and save it on the draft.

campaignBuilder.needsInvite: To send a LinkedIn message, add a LinkedIn invite first.

parallel.title: Allow people who are in another active campaign
parallel.body: A reply to either campaign stops both. The change applies to the next people added and the next sends: it adds no one left out before.

snippet.title: Add an AI snippet
snippet.description: One short line for each person, written only from the research the list already holds. It never searches the web.
snippet.label: Field name
snippet.promptPlaceholder: One sentence that links their recent news to our offer.
snippet.inputsMax: {max, plural, one {# column at most} other {{max, number, credits} columns at most}}
snippet.noResearch: This list has no AI research column yet. Add one on the list, then come back.
snippet.noPeople: No one in this campaign can still get a step and has a row on the campaign list, so there is no one to write a snippet for.
snippet.coverage: Covers {rows, plural, one {# person} other {{rows, number, credits} people}} of {people, plural, one {# person} other {{people, number, credits} people}}: only people who can still get a step and have a row on the campaign list, {max, plural, one {# person} other {{max, number, credits} people}} at most in one run.
snippet.estimate: Up to {credits, plural, one {# credit} other {{credits, number, credits} credits}}
snippet.estimateDetail: {price, plural, one {# credit} other {{price, number, credits} credits}} for each snippet delivered · {people, plural, one {# person with research} other {{people, number, credits} people with research}}
snippet.estimateNote: The estimate counts only people with research in these columns. A person with none gets no snippet and costs nothing.
snippet.estimateNone: No one in this campaign has research in these columns, so there is nothing to write.
snippet.estimateFailed: We could not estimate the cost.
snippet.unavailable: We could not load the campaign list.
snippet.createFailed: We could not add the AI snippet.
snippet.progress: {done, number, credits} of {people, plural, one {# person} other {{people, number, credits} people}} done
snippet.progressNote: You can close this window: the snippets keep coming. The field is already in the field list.
snippet.done: {filled, plural, one {# snippet written} other {{filled, number, credits} snippets written}} · {credits, plural, one {# credit} other {{credits, number, credits} credits}} charged
snippet.doneNote: {field} is in the field list. Add it to a step with + Field.
snippet.paused: AI snippets are paused for now.

variants.sameAsA: People in copy B get the same text as copy A for this step.
variants.useA: Use copy A for this step
variants.title: A/B test
variants.switch: Compare two copies of the messages
variants.help: Each person who joins gets copy A or copy B and keeps it, with its text, until the end. The texts cannot change after launch.
variants.share: Share of people who get copy B
variants.saved: The share is saved at once. Copy B is saved with the steps.
variants.offBody: Copy B is removed from every step, and deleted when you save the draft.
